snippet.title: Hull Rupture - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover Hull Rupture, the new base-building tower defense roguelike from Konfa Games, the studio behind Despotism 3K, Slime 3k and Despot's Game.
Manage resources, modules, and human lives to keep the ship moving at all costs.
Wishlist on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358660/Hull_Rupture/
